requirements.quote:
If the zone does not contain any RRsets matching <SNAME, SCLASS>
   either exactly or via wildcard name expansion, then the name server
   MUST include the following NSEC RRs in the Authority section, along
   with their associated RRSIG RRs:

   o  An NSEC RR proving that there is no exact match for <SNAME,
      SCLASS>.

   o  An NSEC RR proving that the zone contains no RRsets that would
      match <SNAME, SCLASS> via wildcard name expansion.

   In some cases, a single NSEC RR may prove both of these points.  If
   it does, the name server SHOULD only include the NSEC RR and its
   RRSIG RR(s) once in the Authority section.

   If space does not permit inclusion of these NSEC and RRSIG RRs, the
   name server MUST set the TC bit (see Section 3.1.1).

   The owner names of these NSEC and RRSIG RRs are not subject to
   wildcard name expansion when these RRs are included in the Authority
   section of the response.

   Note that this form of response includes cases in which SNAME
   corresponds to an empty non-terminal name within the zone (a name
   that is not the owner name for any RRset but that is the parent name
   of one or more RRsets).
requirements.condition: The zone contains no RRsets matching <SNAME, SCLASS> either exactly or via wildcard name expansion; this includes the stated cases where SNAME is an empty non-terminal name within the zone (not an RRset owner but a parent of one or more RRsets).
requirements.required_behavior: The name server MUST include an NSEC RR proving that there is no exact match for <SNAME, SCLASS> in the Authority section of the name error response.
requirements.why_checkable: A zone and query with neither an exact nor wildcard match allow checking the response Authority section for an NSEC proof of the missing exact match, including the stated empty non-terminal cases.

requirements.condition: A single NSEC RR proves both the absence of an exact match for <SNAME, SCLASS> and the absence of a match via wildcard name expansion in this name error response.
requirements.required_behavior: The name server SHOULD include that NSEC RR only once in the Authority section.
requirements.why_checkable: When one NSEC RR establishes both proofs, its occurrence count in the Authority section checks the advisory deduplication behavior.

   either exactly or via wildcard name expansion, then the name server
   MUST include the following NSEC RRs in the Authority section, along
   with their associated RRSIG RRs:

   o  An NSEC RR proving that there is no exact match for <SNAME,

requirements.condition: The name server includes an NSEC RR for this name error response in the Authority section.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Apply wildcard name expansion to the owner name of that NSEC RR.
requirements.why_checkable: An NSEC record with a wildcard owner allows comparing its response owner name against the original owner name.
